titre: Full Stack Developer — Business Process Digitalisation
accroche: I turn processes that live in spreadsheets and Word templates into applications teams use every day. *Ten applications and websites I shipped are live*, four of them fully open source.

lignes: Two core activities ran on shared spreadsheets and hand-copied Word templates: tender responses and recruitment. *I designed, built and shipped both replacement applications.*

The deadline and scope of supply had to be found by hand in files running to hundreds of pages, some scanned. The tool finds them and *shows the exact passage it took them from* — all that is left is to confirm.
*The HR team switched without changing a habit* — the new tracker uses the exact columns of the spreadsheet it replaced, and exports to the same format.

entrees.titre: Hope Traders Academy — Freelance Full Stack Developer
lignes: *Three web products delivered end to end*, each with its own site and application: a course and membership platform, an activity journal, a market analysis terminal.
*Chatbots and automations*: answers to common questions, social posting, email sequences — built with n8n, Make, Zapier and SendPulse *rather than code*, so the client can change them without me.
Each tool is run directly by the client, with no day-to-day technical involvement.

entrees.sousTitre: Contract work for Bailey Assurances, CRFPE, Interloc
lignes: Custom web applications for three clients: full development, from interface to database.
Brochure sites and online stores built from supplied designs; worked alongside design and marketing in an agile setup.
PHP 8.4, Laravel 13, Vue 3 and PostgreSQL. *The legal number is reserved in the same transaction as the invoice*: a failure consumes nothing, and the series stays gap-free.

The database itself refuses two invoices sharing a number, any rewrite of an issued document, or a payment above the amount due. Compliant PDF export, documented REST API. *103 tests, 246 assertions.*

entrees.titre: RDV Santé — appointments and a live waiting queue
lignes: Java 21, Spring Boot 4, Angular 22, Apache Kafka and PostgreSQL. Four autonomous services exchanging events rather than calling one another: *if one goes down the others carry on*.
*A transactional outbox* guarantees no event is lost or emitted twice; a partial unique index forbids two patients taking the same slot. Tested against real PostgreSQL and Kafka.

Carries a bid from the first document through to the invoice: intake, automated reading, enforced stages, live dashboard. *Built for non-technical users* — every screen carries its instructions and a guided tour on first login.

entrees.titre: Recruitment — from stated need to the candidate's first day
lignes: Replaces a shared spreadsheet and folders filed by hand: applicant tracking, generation of hiring documents, automatic archiving. GDPR-compliant — candidate data is flagged, then deleted once its retention period ends.

entrees.sousTitre: Hope Traders Academy · site and application
lignes: Sign-up, subscription billing, content released in stages, messaging with the team, and an admin back office. Runs in the browser and *installs on a phone* like a native app.

entrees.sousTitre: Hope Traders Academy · site and application
lignes: Imports an account's history and turns it into statistics, charts and a calendar; notebook and PDF export. An assistant reads back through the entries and *surfaces what keeps recurring*.

entrees.sousTitre: Hope Traders Academy · site and application
lignes: Pulls together *five scattered public data sources* into a single read, across 67 tracked markets. Accounts, free trial, subscription, and alerts ahead of major releases.

questions: Le titre anglais dit « Business Process Digitalisation ». L'alternative plus recherchée par les recruteurs est « Digital Transformation » — moins précise, mais plus courante. Dis-moi si tu la préfères.
Version SANS PHOTO disponible : au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis, une photo peut faire écarter une candidature. Commande donnée dans la conversation.
avertissements: Traduction rédigée en anglais, pas transposée mot à mot : les tournures suivent l'usage anglophone.
Mêmes faits vérifiés que la version française — aucune affirmation ajoutée à la faveur de la traduction.

La ligne de formation dit « Bac+5 » dans les deux langues. La mention « Master's level » a été retirée de l'anglaise : la règle des candidatures proscrit « Master », et l'arbitrage du 3 octobre ne portait que sur « Bac+5 ».
